note: Curated kits: a few resources that work well together for one kind of job. Installing a kit installs each member that isn't here yet, one visible operation at a time.

kits.name: Web testing
kits.can: Open sites, click through them, read the console and check what broke.

kits.name: Design taste
kits.can: Interfaces that don't look generated: layout, type, motion and polish.

kits.name: Security review
kits.can: Review code, find leaked secrets and test running apps.

kits.name: Video
kits.can: Edit, generate and animate video from code.

kits.name: Reverse engineering
kits.can: Take apart binaries, firmware and running processes.

kits.name: Research and docs
kits.can: Current docs, web pages and Office files, read and turned into text.

kits.name: Memory and context
kits.can: Remember across sessions and fit big codebases into context.

kits.name: 3D and CAD
kits.can: Drive Blender, model parts and prepare them for printing.
